title: Vanilla REDO
description: Vanilla REDO is a Texture Pack that reinforces the Vanilla feel of Java. With several Quality of Life additions, you can't go wrong.
body:
# **Welcome to Vanilla REDO**
> In Vanilla REDO, Minecraft is refined by adding several Quality of Life features that don't ruin the base game.

# **Features Include:**
> - Multiple Texture Fixes
> - Updated Block Particles
> - Dark GUI
> - Smooth Font
> - Texture Variations
> - Tool Withering
> - Audio Dampening (Rain, Portals etc.)
> - Low Shield, Fire, Grass, and Plants
> - Lighting Enhancements

And much much More!

> - To view a full range of features, please visit:
> [REDO Wiki](https://minecraft-redo.gitbook.io/vanillaredo)
